scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:mdt" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "client,mdt,server" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:mdt" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:mdt && npm run build:server
scripts.build:production: npm run build:client && npm run build:mdt && npm run build:server
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/client && npm install && cd ../mdtclient && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.clean: npm run clean:client && npm run clean:mdt && npm run clean:server
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:mdt && npm run lint:server
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:mdt && npm run test:server
